name: Gargoyle
description: A Gargoyle is a magically animated construct, crafted from stone to serve as a vigilant sentinel, often indistinguishable from ordinary statues in plain sight. Its ability to remain motionless for long periods, combined with its durability and raw strength, makes it a perfect guardian, ambushing intruders with crushing force when the need arises.

actions.name: Stone Claw
actions.description: The gargoyle sweeps their stone claw at a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Gaze of the Watcher
actions.description: The gargoyle flashes their eyes, causing creatures within a 3 unit cone to become blind until the end of their next turn. A creature can only be affected by this blinding effect once per engagement.

actions.name: Ram
actions.description: The gargoyle uses the Shove action as a free action, dealing 1d6 physical damage on a success.

traits.name: Natural Flight
traits.description: The gargoyle must take the Move action once per turn to maintain their currently elevation while using their fly speed. If not, they immediately fall at the end of their turn.

traits.name: Reinforced Construct
traits.description: The gargoyle counts as a Reinforced Object and takes no damage unless 10 or more damage is dealt of a single type is done to it after applying mitigations. Additionally, the gargoyle is immutable.
